surprise:advance-start.title: Advance to START
surprise:advance-start.text: Move forward to START and collect the landing bonus.

surprise:go-to-holding.title: Go to Holding
surprise:go-to-holding.text: Go directly to Holding. Do not pass START and do not collect a salary.

surprise:next-flight.title: Take the next flight
surprise:next-flight.text: Advance to the nearest transit hub. If it is unowned you may buy it; otherwise pay its owner double rent.

surprise:next-train.title: Board the next train
surprise:next-train.text: Advance to the nearest transit hub. If it is unowned you may buy it; otherwise pay its owner double rent.

surprise:customs-inspection.title: Customs inspection
surprise:customs-inspection.text: Your baggage is opened and reweighed. Pay $150 in duty.

surprise:overbooked.title: Overbooked
surprise:overbooked.text: Go back three tiles and settle whatever you land on.

surprise:currency-slide.title: Currency slide
surprise:currency-slide.text: The exchange rate moves against you. Pay $40 for every city you own.

surprise:street-repairs.title: Street repairs
surprise:street-repairs.text: Pay $40 for every development block you own and $115 for every landmark.

surprise:advance-paris.title: Advance to Paris
surprise:advance-paris.text: Take the scenic route to Paris. Collect your salary if you pass START.

surprise:speeding-fine.title: Speeding fine
surprise:speeding-fine.text: You were caught between terminals. Pay a $100 fine.

surprise:advance-rome.title: Advance to Rome
surprise:advance-rome.text: A detour through Rome. Collect your salary if you pass START.

surprise:sponsor-festival.title: Sponsor a festival
surprise:sponsor-festival.text: Pay every other player $50. Everyone remembers you fondly.

surprise:advance-heathrow.title: Advance to Heathrow
surprise:advance-heathrow.text: Rebooked through Heathrow. Collect your salary if you pass START.

surprise:lost-luggage.title: Lost luggage
surprise:lost-luggage.text: Replace what was in the case. Pay the bank $80.

surprise:diplomatic-pass.title: Diplomatic pass
surprise:diplomatic-pass.text: Keep this card. Use it once to leave Holding for free.

surprise:emergency-landing.title: Emergency landing
surprise:emergency-landing.text: Advance to the nearest utility. If it is owned, roll the dice and pay its owner ten times the roll.

treasure:tourism-grant.title: Tourism board grant
treasure:tourism-grant.text: The season went well. Collect $200 from the bank.

treasure:bank-error.title: Bank error in your favour
treasure:bank-error.text: An old transfer clears twice. Collect $150.

treasure:heritage-grant.title: Heritage grant
treasure:heritage-grant.text: Your restoration work is recognised. Collect $100.

treasure:annual-dividend.title: Annual dividend
treasure:annual-dividend.text: Collect $30 for every city you own.

treasure:rail-concession.title: Rail concession
treasure:rail-concession.text: A route through your holdings pays a licence fee. Collect $120.

treasure:insurance-payout.title: Insurance payout
treasure:insurance-payout.text: A claim you had forgotten about settles. Collect $100.

treasure:duty-refund.title: Duty refund
treasure:duty-refund.text: A customs charge is reversed. Collect $150.

treasure:consulate-letter.title: Consulate letter
treasure:consulate-letter.text: Keep this card. Use it once to leave Holding for free.

treasure:tourism-boom.title: Tourism boom
treasure:tourism-boom.text: Visitors flood the board. Every player collects $25 from the bank.

treasure:design-prize.title: Won a design prize
treasure:design-prize.text: Your terminal renovation wins an award. Collect $80.

treasure:mature-bond.title: Mature bond
treasure:mature-bond.text: A long bond finally matures. Collect $250.

treasure:sponsorship-deal.title: Sponsorship deal
treasure:sponsorship-deal.text: A carrier pays to put its name on your routes. Collect $180.

treasure:ticket-refund.title: Unused ticket refund
treasure:ticket-refund.text: A cancelled trip is refunded. Collect $60.

treasure:tax-rebate.title: Property tax rebate
treasure:tax-rebate.text: The council overcharged you last quarter. Collect $90.

treasure:handler-tip.title: Baggage handler's tip
treasure:handler-tip.text: A quiet word about an upcoming route pays off. Collect $70.

treasure:advance-start.title: Advance to START
treasure:advance-start.text: Move forward to START and collect the landing bonus.
